name: chicken
description: A chicken that seems unusually knowing.

topics.advice: The chicken clucks mysteriously about legal matters.
topics.food: The chicken eyes your inventory hungrily.
topics.geometry: The chicken pecks at architectural anomalies.
topics.loss: The chicken tilts its head as if it already knows what went missing and where it wandered.

reputation_bands.high: The chicken seems pleased with you.

topics.geometry: The overseer approves of clean angles.

name: minor_clerk
description: A harried clerk managing intake and queue flow.

topics.queue: The clerk explains the queue system patiently.
topics.waiting: The clerk understands the necessity of waiting.
topics.catalogue: If you cannot name what was lost, the department will name it for you, and it will probably be less flattering.

reputation_bands.low: The clerk is curt with you.

name: frank
description: Frank Gate Clerk, the ultimate bureaucrat.

topics.forms: All things must pass through the Desk.
topics.appeal: Denial is not the end of a form. It is a stage.
topics.chicken: No poultry in active review. Unofficially, the bird has instincts.

reputation_bands.low: Your paperwork arrives with a smell of improvisation.
reputation_bands.high: Frank slides the form back with one corrected mark already stamped.

name: goblin_stapler
description: A goblin with surprisingly strong opinions about binding.

topics.paper: The goblin staples things without asking permission.
topics.chaos: The goblin cackles at regulatory confusion.
topics.shortcuts: The goblin knows paths the clerks dont: The term 'reroute' is practically sacred.

reputation_bands.low: The goblin tosses your papers in a pile.
reputation_bands.mid: The goblin whispers a less terrible route.
reputation_bands.high: The goblin binds your documents neatly and with a wry grin.

name: paper_sprite
description: A tiny sprite made of parchment and ink.

topics.ink: Ink is the only thing that keeps a memory from disappearing.
topics.rewrite: Sometimes a story is better if you forget how it started.
topics.ledger: Ledgers are only as true as the hands that write them.

reputation_bands.low: The sprite darts away before you can touch it.
reputation_bands.mid: The sprite hums a crooked tune.
reputation_bands.high: The sprite offers to help you rewrite something you regret.

name: records_moth
description: A moth that tends lost records with dusty devotion.

topics.records: Records are never truly lost, only misfiled into shame.
topics.forms: Forms want to be completed. They resent improvisation.
topics.stamps: A stamp is a memory that the system agrees to keep.

reputation_bands.low: The moth hides in the stacks.
reputation_bands.mid: The moth flutters near a useful cabinet.
reputation_bands.high: The moth guides you to what you need without judgment.
